title: Magazine
description: Magazine, in magazine cover cinematography, is a designed portrait with air for a masthead you will not render: fashion lighting, thumbnail-readable wardrobe, a page that knows it will be sold. Layout first, person second, and fake headlines will garble.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Arrivals, identity as product, fashion: beauty key, clean edges, negative space at top or side. Superstar is the fame.
Magazine is the geometry of the cover. A war still does not want this unless the joke is a cover.
It is the wrong tool when the frame is dirty, flash-stolen, or packed to the edges. If it cannot survive a masthead, it is a pretty portrait, not this look.
Do not draw type.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Magazine in film?
A cover recipe: fashion lighting, designed negative space, wardrobe that reads small. You do not render the masthead. The page is the shot.
Magazine vs Superstar
Superstar is fame in the light. Magazine is fame as layout. If there is no air for a title, you wanted superstar, or you failed the cover.
When should I use Magazine?
Fashion, identity as product, arrivals. Skip war stills and any frame that cannot spare a masthead.
How do I prompt Magazine for AI image or video?
85mm, beauty key, empty air, then: Magazine cover of [Subject], masthead space, fashion lighting, a page that knows it will be sold. Forbid letters.
